Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 Gaming Laptop
Step into high-performance gaming with the Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10. Powered by the 13th Gen Intel® Core™ i7-13650HX processor and NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5070 Laptop GPU, it delivers powerful performance for modern AAA gaming, competitive esports, streaming, content creation and demanding workloads.
The NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5070 Laptop GPU features 8GB GDDR7 graphics memory, a maximum TGP of 115W and support for NVIDIA DLSS 4, providing advanced AI-powered performance, realistic ray-traced graphics and smoother gameplay.
Enjoy fluid and color-accurate visuals on the 15.3-inch WUXGA IPS display. Its 1920 × 1200 resolution, 16:10 aspect ratio, 165Hz refresh rate, 100% sRGB color coverage, Dolby Vision® and factory X-Rite® color calibration provide an excellent experience for both gaming and creative work.

raw_description:
Some laptops play games. The
Legion 5 15IAX10
lives them. Under its Eclipse Black lid sits an
Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 255HX
with 20 cores pushing up to 5.2GHz, paired with
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060
graphics, and both feed a
15.1" WQXGA OLED
screen that renders your world in deep, true color at 165Hz. From the first raid to the last ranked match of the night, this is the machine that keeps up with you.
Uncompromising Performance
The
Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 255HX
combines 8 Performance-cores and 12 Efficient-cores for 20 cores / 20 threads of raw processing power, boosting to 5.2GHz with 30MB of Intel® Smart Cache. A dedicated
Lenovo LA3 AI chip
plus an Intel® AI Boost NPU (up to 13 TOPS) tune performance, thermals and battery life in real time, so the Legion stays fast and cool exactly when it matters.
GeForce RTX™ 5060. Built for the Win.
The
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060 Laptop GPU
with
8GB GDDR7
runs at a full
115W TGP
and boosts to 2497MHz, delivering 572 AI TOPS for next-level AI performance. Enjoy realistic ray tracing, NVIDIA DLSS frame boosting, and the headroom to stream, create and compete on the same machine.
A Display You Can Feel
The
15.1" WQXGA (2560×1600) OLED
panel hits
1000 nits peak brightness
, covers
100% DCI-P3
, and is certified
DisplayHDR™ True Black 600
with
Dolby Vision®
. Blacks are truly black, colors pop, and every frame arrives at a silky
165Hz
. Once you play on OLED, going back is not an option.
Built Around You
24-zone RGB backlit Arabic keyboard
lights up your setup, HARMAN stereo speakers with Nahimic Audio put you in the middle of the action, and the
80Wh battery
with a 245W Slim Tip adapter keeps the fight going. On top, an
aluminum lid
, Eclipse Black finish, and a
5.0MP camera with e-shutter
complete a laptop that looks as sharp as it plays, starting at just 1.9 kg.
Connect Everything
One
Thunderbolt™ 4
port, USB-C with 100W Power Delivery and DisplayPort 2.1, three USB-A ports (one Always On),
HDMI 2.1
up to 8K/60Hz, and Gigabit Ethernet mean external monitors, peripherals and fast internet are always one cable away.
Wi-Fi 7
and Bluetooth® 5.4 handle the wireless side.
Key Features
Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 255HX: 20C (8P + 12E) / 20T, up to 5.2GHz, 30MB Smart Cache
NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060 8GB GDDR7, 115W TGP, 572 AI TOPS
Lenovo LA3 AI chip + Intel® AI Boost NPU (up to 13 TOPS)
15.1" WQXGA (2560×1600) OLED, 165Hz, 1000 nits peak, 100% DCI-P3
DisplayHDR™ True Black 600 and Dolby Vision® support
32GB (2× 16GB) DDR5-5600 dual-channel memory
1TB M.2 2242 PCIe 4.0×4 NVMe SSD, second M.2 2280 slot free
24-zone RGB backlit Arabic keyboard
Thunderbolt™ 4, USB-C 100W PD with DP 2.1, 3× USB-A, HDMI 2.1
Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) 2×2 + Bluetooth® 5.4
80Wh battery with 245W Slim Tip fast adapter
Aluminum top / Eclipse Black finish, starting at 1.9 kg
5.0MP camera with e-shutter for privacy
